text:
Predicates:
Likes(x, y) ::: x likes y.
WantsToCompose(x) ::: x wants to compose.
Access(x, y) ::: x has access to y.
Program(y) ::: y is a program.
Compose(x) ::: x will compose.
Premises:
Likes(george, music) → WantsToCompose(george) ::: If George likes music, he wants to compose.
Access(george, z) ∧ Program(z) → Compose(george) ::: If George has access to a program, he can compose.
WantsToCompose(george) ∧ Compose(george) → Compose(george) ::: If George can compose and wants to compose, he will compose.
Conclusion:
Likes(george, music) ∧ Access(george, z) ∧ Program(z) → Compose(george) ::: If George likes music and has access to a program, he will compose.
